We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for a template that when applied to the molecule (target) reproduces Friedel-Crafts acylation (forward). The retrosynthetic step: target molecule is given? The input from previous step: precursors from applying template to molecule gave ["COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(O)C4)cc3)c2N)c1", "F"] So the target molecule is likely the product of Friedel-Crafts acylation: aromatic ring with acyl group (maybe a phenyl with F?). The precursors are the aromatic substrate (with OMe etc) and F (halide). Actually the product is maybe "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(O)C4)cc3)c2N)c1" which is the aromatic amide? Wait the template applied gave precursors: the product is something else? The previous task "make_6_lvl2-apply_template-1" asked to return all possible precursors of applying the template as result of task make_6_lvl2-template_search-1 to the molecule below. So they had a template (found earlier) and applied to a molecule (target) to get precursors. The answer gave two precursors: the aromatic amide and "F". So the template likely is a Friedel-Crafts acylation that adds an acyl group onto an aromatic ring, breaking a halide (F) and forming a ketone (acyl). The product (target) would be the aromatic ring with acyl group attached (maybe a phenyl with a carbonyl attached to something). The precursors are the aromatic substrate (the same as product? Actually the product is the aromatic amide? Wait the product after acylation would be aromatic ring with acyl group attached to it. The precursor aromatic substrate would be the same aromatic ring but without the acyl group? But the given precursor is "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(O)C4)cc3)c2N)c1". That already contains an amide and a heterocycle. That seems like the product after acylation? The other precursor is "F". So maybe the forward reaction is substitution of F by acyl group (acyl chloride) onto aromatic ring. The product would be aromatic ring with acyl group (maybe the same as given). The precursors: aromatic ring with F (aryl halide) and acyl chloride. But they gave "F" as a separate precursor, not acyl chloride. Hmm.

Maybe the template is a halogenation? Actually Friedel-Crafts acylation breaks C-Cl bond (halide) and forms C-C bond (acyl). The halide functional group is gone. So the template would have functional_groups_broken: halide, functional_groups_formed: ketone (or carbonyl). The search returned empty list. Maybe need to search with bonds broken/formed instead. Use bonds_broken: "C-Cl" and bonds_formed: "C-C". Let's try.
